vibe: Objective, rigid, functional. The 'Control Room' for thought.

headings.usage: Headers, Node Titles, Section Labels. Tightly tracked.

body.usage: Transcripts, Data points, Agent IDs, Meta information.

layout.structure: Split View: Fixed Left Sidebar (w-80 or w-96) + Main Canvas Area (flex-1).
layout.sidebar: Flex column, full height, border-r border-zinc-200, strict padding (p-6).
layout.canvas: Relative, overflow-hidden, full height. Background pattern: CSS dotted or grid lines using radial-gradient or repeating-linear-gradient to look like a whiteboard.

agent_config_panel.style: Compact. Input field for Agent ID and Connect button.
agent_config_panel.input: border border-zinc-200 rounded-none px-3 py-2 text-sm font-mono focus:border-[#002FA7] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#002FA7] outline-none transition-colors
agent_config_panel.button: bg-zinc-900 text-white rounded-none px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors

voice_widget.container: Flex items-center justify-between p-4 border border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 rounded-none mt-6
voice_widget.mic_button_idle: p-3 rounded-full bg-zinc-200 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-300 transition-colors
voice_widget.mic_button_active: p-3 rounded-full bg-[#FF3B30] text-white animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,59,48,0.5)]

transcript_display.container: Flex-1 overflow-y-auto mt-6 border-t border-zinc-200 pt-4 space-y-4
transcript_display.user_bubble: text-sm font-mono text-zinc-500 pl-2 border-l-2 border-zinc-300
transcript_display.agent_bubble: text-sm font-mono text-zinc-900 pl-2 border-l-2 border-[#002FA7]

node_card.style: The 'Tactile' Neo-Brutalist variant. Absolute positioned on canvas.
node_card.container: min-w-[200px] bg-white border-2 border-zinc-900 p-4 shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_#18181b] cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing active:shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_#18181b] active:translate-x-[2px] active:translate-y-[2px] transition-all duration-75
node_card.header: flex justify-between items-center mb-2 border-b-2 border-zinc-100 pb-2

connection_lines.style: SVG lines connecting nodes. Stroke color: zinc-300 (or zinc-900 for active), stroke-width: 2. Arrowhead at the end.

motion.nodes: Use framer-motion for smooth entry (scale-up + fade-in) when a new node is generated.
motion.drag: Nodes must be draggable. The shadow compresses on drag (simulating pressing down).

icons.usage: Mic, MicOff, Settings, Plus, Link, Play, Square (Stop).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `framer-motion` for draggable node cards and smooth canvas interactions.
For the infinite canvas, you can implement a simple zoom/pan container using `react-zoom-pan-pinch` or a custom implementation with mouse events.
If building the nodes from scratch, use an array of node objects with x/y coordinates and update them via framer-motion's `onDrag` callback.
Draw connection lines using an absolute SVG layer that spans the entire canvas, mapping lines between node coordinates.

The ElevenLabs agent integration can be mocked using standard Web Audio/Speech APIs or simple simulated timeouts if the actual SDK is not provided, but ensure the UI reacts to 'speaking' and 'listening' states.
Strictly adhere to the typography: IBM Plex Sans for headings/cards and IBM Plex Mono for transcript/inputs. It creates the required 'Swiss/Technical' aesthetic.
Do NOT use generic rounded borders (rounded-md/lg). Stick to sharp edges (rounded-none) or maximum 2px (rounded-sm) for a brutalist/structural feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure transcript text meets 4.5:1 ratio against background.
accessibility.focus: All actionable items must have a clear 2px focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002FA7] focus:outline-none).
